verdict.rationale: Type inference for component inputs and outputs is a fair question for a TypeScript UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack only shows that Angular uses TypeScript and has @Input/@Output components. Nothing documents inputs or emitted events being typed automatically without annotations, and one older community report says template typos produced no compile-time error.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic type inference for component props and emitted events without writing extra type annotations
